tolerance.note: pass if |got - want| <= max(abs, one float ulp of want). A chip whose FPU is single-precision (Real = float) uses abs_single_fpu instead, because it computes the angle 2*pi*x in float; for the same reason tan-rev is only specified there where |tan| <= 1000, with relative tolerance rel, and near its poles it returns a large finite number of unspecified size
